name: rtorrent-mcp

tools.description: Multi-source search: anime, manga, TV, movies, ebooks, metadata (13 actions)

tools.name: nlp_management

tools.name: legal_management
tools.description: Austrian copyright risk context and advice (4 actions)

tools.name: system_management
tools.description: Help, status, health, info, analyze (5 actions)

tools.name: agentic_rtorrent_workflow
tools.description: LLM-orchestrated multi-step torrent workflows via sampling
